chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad, from Sahl ibn Ziyād, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿAbd al-Karīm ibn ʿAmr, from al-Ḥasan ibn Ziyād, who said:

Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام was asked about a man who urinates, then a small spot of his urine reaches part of his thigh, and he prays, then later remembers that he had not washed it. He said: “He should wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).”
ai.seo_question: If someone remembers after salat (prayer) that urine had remained on his body, must he repeat the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning najasah affecting the body before salat (prayer). If a person prays while a spot of urine remains unwashed on his thigh and only remembers afterward, he must wash it and repeat his salat (prayer).
